import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = {
    "Source9_28_0": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_0.csv",
    "Source9_28_1": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_1.csv",
    "Source9_28_2": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_2.csv",
    "Source9_28_3": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_3.csv",
    "Source9_28_4": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_4.csv",
    "Source9_28_5": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_5.csv",
    "Source9_28_6": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_6.csv",
    "Source9_28_7": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_7.csv",
    "Source9_28_8": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_8.csv",
    "Source9_28_9": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_9.csv",
}

# Step 1: Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_0 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_0"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'KEYWORDS_NUM']
df_1 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_1"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM']
df_2 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_2"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'INBOUND_CALLS_NUM']
df_3 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_3"], index_col=0)  # ['CANCELED', 'ROW_WID', ..., 'ARPU', ...]
df_4 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_4"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'TECHSUPPORT_NUM']
df_5 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_5"], index_col=0)  # same schema as df_3
df_6 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_6"], index_col=0)  # same schema as df_3
df_7 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_7"], index_col=0)  # same schema as df_3
df_8 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_8"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'INTERACTIONS_NUM']
df_9 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source9_28_9"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'VISITS_NUM']

# Step 2: Union all source tables with the same schema as df_3 (which includes ARPU)
# These are df_3, df_5, df_6, df_7
df_union_arpu = pd.concat([df_3, df_5, df_6, df_7], ignore_index=True)

# Step 3: From the unioned df, keep only ROW_WID and ARPU columns (ARPU is the target column)
df_arpu = df_union_arpu[['ROW_WID', 'ARPU']]

# Step 4: Join all other source tables (aspect tables) on ROW_WID
# These tables are: df_0(KEYWORDS_NUM), df_1(COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM), df_2(INBOUND_CALLS_NUM),
# df_4(TECHSUPPORT_NUM), df_8(INTERACTIONS_NUM), df_9(VISITS_NUM)

# We will do left joins starting from df_arpu (which has ROW_WID and ARPU)
df_joined = df_arpu.copy()

# Join df_0
df_joined = df_joined.merge(df_0, on='ROW_WID', how='left')

# Join df_1
df_joined = df_joined.merge(df_1, on='ROW_WID', how='left')

# Join df_2
df_joined = df_joined.merge(df_2, on='ROW_WID', how='left')

# Join df_4
df_joined = df_joined.merge(df_4, on='ROW_WID', how='left')

# Join df_8
df_joined = df_joined.merge(df_8, on='ROW_WID', how='left')

# Join df_9
df_joined = df_joined.merge(df_9, on='ROW_WID', how='left')

# Step 5: The target table schema is only ['ARPU'] (float)
# The target examples show only ARPU column, so we project only ARPU column

# Step 6: According to the target examples, ARPU is float, ensure type is float
df_result = df_joined[['ARPU']].copy()
df_result['ARPU'] = df_result['ARPU'].astype(float)

# Step 7: Write the result to the target CSV file without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_result.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
